Thanksgiving: 9:00am – Close. Christmas Eve: 11:00am – 4:00pm. Christmas Day: 3:00pm – Close. New Years Eve: 9:00am – Close. New Years Day: 11:00am – Close.

faq.q: How many people does the banquet room hold?
faq.a: The Schwoegler's Banquet Center comfortably seats up to 150 guests and features reasonably priced food and beverages.

faq.q: How do I book a party?
faq.a: Contact us to book your next party, meeting or function at 608-833-7272 or email: info@schwoegler.com

faq.q: Do you do kids birthday parties?
faq.a: Have your next kids birthday party with us. We do all the setup and clean up. Parties can feature bowling, food, beverage, party room and more.
Full bar and grill menu featuring appetizers, burgers, sandwiches, wings, salad, pizza and a Friday fish fry. Dine in or carryout.

faq.q: What else do you have besides bowling?
faq.a: Two outdoor volleyball courts, pinball and darts, bumper bowling, Madd Interactive bowling games, a sports bar with happy hour, a banquet hall and a meeting room. Special events include Karaoke, Trivia, Bingo (Thursdays at 6:30pm) and Live Entertainment.
We have multiple leagues for all types of bowlers. We have men's, women's, mixed, couples and youth leagues available.

faq.q: What happens if volleyball is rained out?
faq.a: Check our Facebook page for any rain cancellations. Next week's schedule remains the same if a night is canceled. The week will be added to the end if cancelled.
